title: MCP security monitoring and trust-gate output
description: Per-server security evidence, an ALLOW/REVIEW/BLOCK executive decision, downloadable reports, and trusted or candidate baseline records.

reports.title: Server trust reports
reports.description: One structured, redacted monitoring report per enabled server in the default Dataset.

executiveSummary.title: Executive trust-gate summary
executiveSummary.description: Machine-readable run totals, maximum risk, and the overall ALLOW, REVIEW, or BLOCK decision.

markdownReport.title: Markdown security report
markdownReport.description: Human-readable decisions and prioritized findings for tickets, reviews, and AI workflows.

csvReport.title: CSV evidence report
csvReport.description: Formula-safe spreadsheet export of server decisions and classified findings.

trustedBaselines.title: Trusted baselines
trustedBaselines.description: Trusted normalized baseline records created only by an explicitly selected mutating mode or exact candidate promotion.

candidateBaselines.title: Candidate baselines
candidateBaselines.description: Candidate normalized baseline records retained for review until replaced by an ordinary candidate-writing run or consumed by a successful exact-lineage promotion.
